svg.title: CO platform: layers, what governs what, hard vs soft enforcement
svg.desc: Governing layer sits above; platform spine in the middle; two agents below. Solid = built and hard-enforced, dashed = soft or not yet built.
svg.text: Governing layer — humans own this, agents never write it
Agents — execute within scope the gateway sets
dashed = soft (held by review + evals) or not yet built
What's hard vs soft right now (the honest map)
The rule to replicate at CO
Humans own the governing layer. The gateway sets scope. Agents execute within it.
Soft rules need watching; they fail quietly. Hard rules protect the worst outcomes.
